messages:
maya: Heads-up — we need a compact asset bundle for the inference economics push. Primary deadline: first draft by Thu EOD. Live webinar Tue. Can design produce visuals for webinar, social, and SDR one-sheet?

carl: Priorities (ranked):
 • hero comparison chart (ms latency vs $/1k tokens) across 4 model categories
 • social set: 1080x1080 static, 1080x1080 animated GIF (3 frames max)
 • webinar slide deck master + 2 data slides (findings + methodology)
 • sales one-pager PDF (A4 + US letter), plus a short email HTML header image
 • two paid-social headline variants and short body copy (90 chars)

jo: Can you add exact export specs and the short copy for the one-pager? Also need alt text and an accessibility checklist for images.

amanda: Quick compliance note: for EU-facing copy avoid language like "processing user data". Use neutral terms such as "inference economics" or "model serving costs". Also hold on country-specific CTAs until localization plan.

maya: CSV for hero chart (use for axis labels and alt text):
```
model,family,median_latency_ms,cost_per_1k_tokens_usd
raven-1,open,98,0.22
redwood-x,redwood,38,0.20
minerva-2,commercial,67,0.50
temporal-7,research,130,0.12
```
Chart guidance: latency on left (ms), cost on right ($). Use solid lines for open/research, dotted for commercial. Redwood family should use brand blue (#0069FF). Font: Inter. Provide SVG + 2x PNG exports.

sophia: Picking this up. Timeline check: if I get final copy + any icon preferences today, I can deliver initial assets Thu 6pm PT. Questions:
 • GIF concept — token stream animation vs morphing line chart?
 • Background — flat color or subtle gradient allowed?
 • Do we need a grayscale print variant?

carl: GIF = morphing cost/latency tradeoff (clean). Gradient is OK if subtle and within brand palette (max two tones). Yes, please include grayscale print variant for the one-pager and hero chart.

sophia: Plan of deliverables:
 • hero chart (SVG color + grayscale PNG) with embedded data table for screen readers
 • 3 social squares (static + optimized GIF) — variants for organic/paid
 • slide master + 2 data slides (Key takeaways; Methodology & dataset)
 • sales one-pager (print-ready PDFs A4/US letter + web PNG + small email header)
 • 2 headline A/B PNGs and a 90-char copy file for ad platforms
I'll attach alt text drafts and a short note explaining any brand deviations.

sophia: ETA for first proofs: Thu 18:00 PT. Will post previews here and in #marketing-design. :eyes:

maya: Link to source dataset & brand icons: https://drive.redwood.ai/marketing/inference-econ/2026/dataset.csv — use "cache" icon from pattern library and the "dedicated-stack" glyph. Add a small footnote: "*Methodology and raw data: link" for the one-pager.

jo: I27ll drop the one-pager microcopy and alt text by tomorrow noon. For the paid headlines, we27re testing: (A) "Cut inference spend without sacrificing latency" (B) "Deliver lower-cost, predictable LLM inference" — keep lengths < 90 chars.

amanda: Also flag: EU legal wants no implied SLAs in public materials. Avoid exact uptime claims. Use language like "designed for predictable latency and cost". For FR/DE CTAs we27ll provide translations after first pass.

design-bot: New task created: MARKETING-4999 2D Assets for inference economics launch (owner: @sophia). Due: 2026-03-26. Preview builds will be posted.

sophia: Uploading interim previews to shared drive and will post thumbnails here when ready. Will include editable Figma file link and export checklist.

maya: Please include short reasoning line for any deviation from brand (e.g., gradient choice or chart emphasis) and include suggested copy variations for CTAs that are compliant with EU notes.

sophia: Roger that. Posting first thumbnails in ~4 hours.

design-bot: Previews uploaded: https://preview.redwood.ai/marketer/4999 (3 variants).
